text:
Priya: Hey team — I opened #4321, it's a tidy SDK snippet update for the streaming examples in the SDK guide. Needs a docs preview and one reviewer before we can merge. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321

Alex: I can review but the docs-preview job is failing consistently for that PR. Saw `link-check` complaining about a relative asset path in the snippet.

CI Bot: docs-preview: build failed on PR 4321 — step `link-check` exited with code 1. Logs: 
```
ERROR: /site/content/sdk/streaming.md: broken link to /assets/sdk/old-streaming.png
```

Tessa: Ugh, that file got renamed in a previous PR. The snippet references the old name. Priya, can you update the path in the snippet or point me to the correct asset?

Priya: Yep on it. I replaced `old-streaming.png` with `streaming-v2.png` locally and re-ran the preview script — still hitting the same `link-check` error in CI though. Locally `make preview` succeeds.

Sam: Sounds like the preview env caching assets differently. Could be the assets compile step didn't trigger. @Docs Rotation Bot — any recent changes to the static asset pipeline?

Docs Rotation Bot: last deploy: static-assets service updated 7 days ago (release 2026.03.14). No known breaking changes.

Alex: Two options: (A) Priya pushes a tiny retry commit (touch the md file) to invalidate cache and re-trigger preview, or (B) a reviewer with deploy perms can force a rebuild of docs-preview for that PR. I can take review if we get a green preview.

Tessa: I don't have the perms to trigger a rebuild. Priya if you can push, I'll review immediately after CI passes.

Priya: Pushed 4321+docs-fix (updated image path and added a short HTML comment). Triggered the preview via Github UI.

CI Bot: docs-preview: build started for PR 4321.

CI Bot: docs-preview: build failed on PR 4321 — step `asset-collector` exited with code 2. Logs:
```
ERROR: asset-collector: missing asset streaming-v2.png in S3 bucket staging-assets-1
```

Sam: OK that explains local vs CI: the preview job pulls assets from S3 staging, and the new asset wasn't uploaded. Priya, did you add the PNG to the repo or just reference it?

Priya: I added it to /static/assets and committed — but we rely on the separate asset upload job for S3. I forgot that step. My bad.

Alex: Quick fix: either upload the asset to staging S3 or change the snippet to use the existing hosted image `https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/streaming.png` and we can patch it later. Which is faster?

Priya: Uploading to S3 will take ~5–10 mins (I need creds), using the CDN link is faster. I'll do the CDN change now.

Priya: Pushed 4321+cdn-fallback. Triggered preview.

CI Bot: docs-preview: build started for PR 4321.

CI Bot: docs-preview: build succeeded for PR 4321.

Alex: Nice. I'm starting the review now.

Tessa: If Alex's review is quick, can we merge before the EOD? There's a downstream SDK snippet consumer waiting (internal product demo).

Alex: Left a small nit about wording in the example, nothing blocking. Approving after nit addressed.

Priya: Updated wording per nit. Thanks!

Alex: Approved :thumbsup:

Sam: Two small ops notes: (1) Priya, after merge please follow up with an asset-upload ticket so staging covers future previews; (2) Docs rotation, this sequence highlights a coverage gap — if the reviewer on duty doesn't have deploy/s3 creds, preview can stall. Can we add a fallback reviewer in rotation with the necessary perms?

Docs Rotation Bot: Noted. I'll add a backup reviewer slot for the next rotation.

Priya: Merged. Thanks everyone.

Tessa: Thanks — great coordination. :party_parrot:

Sam: Filing the follow-up ticket now: https://go.redwood/ISSUE-789 (assigning to Priya for asset upload).

Priya: Will handle the ticket tomorrow AM.

Alex: Quick retrospective: push tiny sequential changes to re-trigger preview if CI is flaky; keep `cdn-fallback` as a pattern for assets referenced only in docs; and rotation team to add at least one reviewer with staging perms.

Tessa: Agreed. I'll write up a short blurb in the docs-ops checklist.

Priya: Closing the loop — PR merged and demo unblocked. Appreciated!
